# Comparison `fig4_thinking_min_vs_default`: `txt0` [`repro_fig4`](../txt0_repro_fig4/README.md) (A) vs `txt1` [`repro_fig4_default`](../txt1_repro_fig4_default/README.md) (B)

- A: Text benchmark, using the paper's prompt sent unchanged (text_verbatim), with thinking set to min (the lowest reasoning each provider allows), on 8 models. Reasoning summaries are saved.
- B: Text benchmark, using the paper's prompt sent unchanged (text_verbatim), with thinking set to default (each provider decides how much to reason), on 8 models. Reasoning summaries are saved.

Thinking min (A) vs default (B), per LLM, Fig. 4 (text), the paper's verbatim prompt. Our Claude client sends the same request for min and default, so 314 of each Claude model's 319 default replies are reused from repro_fig4 (WORKLOG 2026-10-12, "Fig. 4 with thinking: default").
